The best Zoho consultants in 2026 are the firms that match your Zoho apps, your region and how much automation you need on top of the CRM. A Zoho CRM setup for a 10-person sales team is a few weeks of work. A Zoho One rollout that ties CRM, Books, Desk and Creator together runs for months, and the consultant you pick decides whether those apps share clean data or drift apart.
This guide compares 9 Zoho consultants and Zoho partners, with published prices where they exist, the Zoho apps each firm covers, the regions they serve, and a framework to pick one.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. We put ourselves at #1 because we set up Zoho and build the automation and AI layer on top of it in the same team. We are not a Zoho partner, so if you want a Premium Zoho partner, a Zoho Books specialist or a local team in Canada, the UK or Germany, one of the other firms below fits better, and we say which.
Best Zoho consultants: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall for automation-first teams: Zoho CRM setup plus n8n workflows, enrichment, lead routing and AI agents that read and write to Zoho.
Zenatta: Best for US mid-market Zoho One rollouts: a Zoho Premium partner that combines CRM, Creator apps and Zoho Books.
Customerization: Best for Canadian SMBs that want transparent hourly billing at a published $180 per hour.
A2Z Cloud: Best for UK businesses and the public sector, with Zoho marketing automation and HR apps in scope.
Codafish: Best for EU and German-speaking companies that need pro-code Zoho integrations.
Brockbank Consulting: Best for US small businesses that want a fixed-price design phase before any build.
Certum Solutions: Best for Zoho Books and finance setup run by accountants.
Encaptechno: Best for teams that want offshore Zoho Creator and CRM development at volume.
ZBrains: Best for field services and manufacturing teams that need Zoho tied into ERP and accounting tools.
Zoho projects or implementations each firm reports on its own site

Source: self-reported figures on each firm's own website, checked 2026-10-21. Certum reports businesses served rather than projects, and ZBrains and ManasFlow publish no Zoho project count, so they are left out.
1. ManasFlow, best overall Zoho consultant for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an AI automation agency that sets up Zoho CRM and then builds the systems around it: lead capture, enrichment, routing, deduplication, outbound sequences and AI agents that update records through the Zoho API. Many Zoho consultants focus on configuration and training. We start there and keep going into the workflows that make the CRM worth paying for.

We run the same kind of stack for our own pipeline (n8n, Instantly, HeyReach, Attio and Unipile), so the outbound and CRM plumbing we build for clients is plumbing we operate every week. The team works in English, French and Arabic, which helps Zoho buyers in Europe, North Africa and the Middle East.
Key features
Zoho CRM setup and data model, scoped on a free call before any build
Zoho CRM automation and implementation with n8n, webhooks and the Zoho API
Weekly CRM hygiene automation: dedupe, stalled-deal flags, lead routing and a Slack digest
Enrichment and outbound connected to Zoho (Clay, Instantly, HeyReach)
AI agents for pre-call research and lead scoring, with every CRM write logged
Delivery in English, French and Arabic
Best for
Sales teams on Zoho CRM that want leads enriched, routed and followed up without manual copying
Companies running outbound tools next to Zoho that need one clean record per account
Teams in Europe and MENA that want a bilingual or trilingual partner
Pricing

Real outbound experience: we run Instantly, HeyReach and n8n on our own pipeline

2. Zenatta, best for US mid-market Zoho One rollouts

Zenatta is one of the most decorated Zoho firms in the Americas. Its site lists Zoho Premium partner status (2022 to 2025), Zoho Partner of the Year Americas in 2024 and 2025, and Global Partner of the Year 2025. The team of 38 specialists works from Las Vegas, Calgary and Belo Horizonte, and the firm reports 1,000+ implementations since 2012.

The work covers implementation, Zoho Creator app development, back-office finance on Zoho Books, team training and Zenatta's own Zoho Marketplace extensions. That breadth suits companies moving several departments onto Zoho One at once.
Key features
Zoho One rollouts across CRM, Creator, Books, Analytics, Desk, Projects and Campaigns
Custom Creator apps and Marketplace extensions
Finance and bookkeeping on Zoho Books
Team training as part of each rollout
Best for
US and Canadian mid-market companies consolidating on Zoho One
Teams that want a high-tier, award-winning partner
Pricing
Sprint-based hourly retainer
Zenatta's FAQ says most mid-market implementations run $15,000 to $60,000
Pros
Highest partner tier and repeated Zoho awards
One firm for CRM, custom apps and finance
Cons
The typical $15K floor rules out very small teams
Zoho only, so less help if your outbound or data stack sits outside Zoho
3. Customerization, best for Canadian SMBs that want flat hourly pricing

Customerization is a Toronto-based Zoho Premium partner that says it is one of 15 in Canada. It reports 300+ implementations for small and mid-sized businesses and keeps all delivery in-house, with consultants who have 7 to 20 years of experience.

Its pricing is the most transparent in this list: $180 per hour on both its pay-as-you-go and project-based plans, and pay-as-you-go has no minimum and is billed every two weeks. You know the rate before the first call.
Key features
Zoho CRM quick-start and advanced integrated setups
Zoho One, Creator and Deluge development
Zoho Flow integrations and staff training
Offices in Concord, Ontario and New York
Best for
Canadian SMBs that want a local Premium partner
Buyers who prefer hourly billing over fixed packages
Pricing
$180 per hour, pay-as-you-go or project-based
No minimum on pay-as-you-go
Pros
Published rate and no minimum on pay-as-you-go
Premium tier with a fully in-house team
Cons
No fixed-price packages, so total cost depends on how well scope is managed
No named Zoho awards on the site
4. A2Z Cloud, best for UK businesses and the public sector

A2Z Cloud is a UK firm that decided to specialise in Zoho in 2012 and now reports 800+ projects. It lists itself as both a Zoho Premium partner and a Zoho Advanced Solutions Provider, and it offers Zoho services through the UK government's G-Cloud framework, which matters for public sector buyers.
Its scope is wider than most: CRM, Campaigns, Marketing Automation, SalesIQ, People, Recruit, Books, Desk, Analytics, Creator and One. It also sells a managed support plan called A2Z Guardian.
Key features
Full-suite Zoho work including HR (People, Recruit) and marketing apps
G-Cloud listing for public sector procurement
A2Z Guardian managed support after go-live
Tech South West outstanding organisation award (2023) and two 2022 tech awards
Best for
UK companies and public bodies buying through G-Cloud
Teams rolling out Zoho marketing automation or HR apps
Pricing
Custom quote
Pros
Broad app coverage beyond CRM
Ongoing managed support offer
Cons
No published pricing
UK focus, so time zones are harder for US teams
5. Codafish, best for EU and German-speaking companies

Codafish was founded in 2018 and works from Berlin, Seestermühe, Madrid and Lajares. The team holds 22 Zoho certifications and reports 250+ projects. Zoho named it Emerging Partner of the Year in 2024 and 2025, and it moved from Advanced to Premium partner in 2025.
Codafish leans technical: integrations, migrations and pro-code work across CRM, Books, Desk, Inventory, Projects, Flow, Analytics and Creator. Its 2025 Pro Code Developer award fits that profile.
Key features
Zoho integrations and data migrations
Pro-code development on Creator and Flow
Offices in Germany and Spain, with a site in English, German and Spanish
22 Zoho certifications across the team
Best for
German-speaking and EU companies that want a local Zoho team
Projects with heavy integration or migration work
Pricing
Custom quote for implementation
Pros
Strong technical depth for integrations
Recent Zoho awards and Premium tier
Cons
Younger firm, Premium only since 2025
EU-focused, with less coverage for North American time zones
6. Brockbank Consulting, best for a fixed-price design phase

Brockbank Consulting runs every project through its own ZBlitz framework, starting with a fixed-price design package before any development. The firm reports 185+ implementations and 1,488+ power users trained, with a 100% US-based team. It describes itself as a top 1% Zoho partner, though the site does not name a tier.

The pricing page is unusually specific: a design package at $2,499 with an early-commitment bonus (regular price $2,999) over 2 to 3 weeks, then development at $200 per hour, usually 15 to 45 hours over 2 to 6 weeks.
Key features
ZBlitz process design before build
Zoho CRM-first, with One, Analytics, Desk and Projects case studies
User training as a core service
Best for
US small businesses that want a fixed cost for the planning phase
Teams that need training as much as configuration
Pricing
Design package $2,499 to $2,999
Development $200 per hour
Pros
Clear published pricing for both phases
Strong focus on adoption and training
Cons
No stated partner tier or headquarters address
Smaller track record than Zenatta or A2Z Cloud
7. Certum Solutions, best for Zoho Books and finance setup

Certum Solutions is an accounting and ERP firm founded in 2012 and based in Monroe, North Carolina. It serves US businesses with $1M to $50M in revenue and holds Authorized status in Zoho's partner program. Zoho is one of several platforms it works on, next to QuickBooks.
If your Zoho project is really a finance project, Certum is the specialist here. It publishes a fixed $1,800 price for Zoho Books setup and configuration, and offers bookkeeping from $200 per month.
Key features
Zoho Books, Inventory, Payroll, CRM and One setup
Bookkeeping, tax and fractional CFO services
Vendor-agnostic accounting advice
Best for
Finance teams moving onto Zoho Books
Businesses that want their accountant and their Zoho consultant to be the same firm
Pricing
Zoho Books setup $1,800 fixed
Bookkeeping from $200 per month
Pros
Accountants doing the finance setup
Fixed published price for Books
Cons
Also an Elite QuickBooks Solution Provider, so Zoho is one practice among several
Not suited to heavy CRM or Creator custom development

8. Encaptechno, best for offshore Zoho development at volume

Encaptechno has been in business since 2009 and reports 1,600+ projects and 350+ clients, the largest project count in this list. It has offices in India, Canada and the USA, and lists itself as a certified Zoho partner without naming a tier.
The firm covers Zoho One, CRM, Books, Creator, Bigin and Workplace, plus ChatGPT integration. Its India-based delivery team suits buyers who need a lot of development hours.
Key features
Zoho Creator and CRM custom development
Zoho One, Books, Bigin and Workplace setup
ChatGPT integration with Zoho
Best for
Teams that need a lot of development hours
Companies comfortable working across time zones
Pricing
Custom quote
